title: MigrateRight
tagline: SAP ECC→S/4HANA master-data migration on real retail data
highlights: Python/SQL SAP ECC→S/4HANA migration case study on real Olist and Online Retail II data, loading 16,167 of 18,330 legacy records.
YAML address rules against Brazilian geolocation data, quarantining 1,719 records (9.38%) with reason codes and no silent drops.
Merged 444 real duplicates with survivorship and showed location-only matching reached only 3.83% precision vs customer_unique_id.
